review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly fixed hypothetical input, not a human-confirmed Decision; only that branch is required. This supports ready with no decision blocker for C, without relaxing the requirement that a material unresolved DEC-001 block paired B at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit and paired-case identity agree across the specification and Gold. The supplied source places normalization, vocabulary defaults and codec construction in core/api.ts, with classic and mini forwarding to the shared implementation. The exact writable scope appropriately includes that implementation and both regression files; forwarding/declaration consumers remain inspection owners, and the build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Boundary and compatibility obligations are coherent, including construction-time TypeError, existing case normalization, no added trim, empty arrays and unchanged non-overlap encode/decode behavior. TASK-VERIFY is independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The allowed implementer and verifier have active supplied project-scoped trusted claims for the bounded work, including data.change, and available assignment capacity; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. A separate active project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct PRD, manifest and evaluation-source digest domains. Model, policy, sampling and budget fingerprints are frozen. Historical operations are explicitly old-version observations, not fresh candidate evidence; none are used to derive expectations. This approval relies on the supplied Service-bound fingerprints and evidence, not independent digest recomputation, code execution or a new human attestation.
